answer: Proposal: earned, non-transferable reputation. Epoch reward share is proportional to reputation — an anchor bound to the key that earned it; only jury-approved answers mint it and the ledger forbids transfers. Answers are embedded; no answer may mirror one already graded, so work cannot be resold across keys. A key at its dawn holds zero influence, so clones must pay full authorship cost per key — n identities earn shares only for n× approved output. The sybil premium is removed, not priced. Assumption: graders check quality; leaks are whole-key resale and jury collusion.
